---- MODULE ZkV3_7_0 ----
EXTENDS ZkV3_7_0Defs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

LOCAL AGFinite == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems

AGProperties == /\ Leadership1
                /\ Leadership2
                /\ PrefixConsistency
                /\ Integrity
                /\ Agreement
                /\ TotalOrder
                /\ LocalPrimaryOrder
                /\ GlobalPrimaryOrder
                /\ PrimaryIntegrity

LEMMA AGCardinalityAlias == \A S: Cardinality(S) = AGFinite!Cardinality(S)
BY DEF Cardinality, AGFinite!Cardinality

LEMMA AGMinimumSingleton == Minimum({1}) = 1
BY SMTT("r3") DEF Minimum

LEMMA AGInitialSafety == Init => AGProperties
<1>1. Init => Leadership1
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitServerVarsL,
    Leadership1, IsLeader, LOOKING, LEADING
<1>2. Init => Leadership2
  <2>1. Cardinality({}) = 0
    BY AGFinite!FS_EmptySet, AGCardinalityAlias, SMTT("r3")
  <2>2. ASSUME Init, NEW e \in 1..MAXEPOCH
        PROVE Cardinality(epochLeader[e]) <= 1
    <3>1. epochLeader[e] = {}
      BY <2>2, SMTT("r3") DEF Init, InitVerifyVars
    <3> QED BY <2>1, <3>1, SMTT("r3")
  <2> QED BY <2>2 DEF Leadership2
<1>3. Init => PrefixConsistency
  <2>1. ASSUME Init, NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server
        PROVE LET smaller == Minimum({lastCommitted[i].index,
                                      lastCommitted[j].index})
              IN \/ smaller = 0
                 \/ /\ smaller > 0
                    /\ \A index \in 1..smaller:
                        TxnEqual(history[i][index], history[j][index])
    <3>1. /\ lastCommitted[i].index = 1
           /\ lastCommitted[j].index = 1
           /\ history[i] = history[j]
      BY <2>1, SMTT("r3") DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitServerVarsL
    <3>2. {lastCommitted[i].index, lastCommitted[j].index} = {1}
      BY <3>1, SMTT("r3")
    <3>3. Minimum({lastCommitted[i].index, lastCommitted[j].index}) = 1
      BY <3>2, AGMinimumSingleton, SMTT("r3")
    <3> QED BY <3>1, <3>3, SMTT("r3") DEF TxnEqual, ZxidEqual
  <2> QED BY <2>1 DEF PrefixConsistency
<1>4. Init => Integrity
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitServerVarsL,
    Integrity, IsFollower, LOOKING, FOLLOWING
<1>5. Init => Agreement
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitServerVarsL,
    Agreement, IsFollower, LOOKING, FOLLOWING
<1>6. Init => TotalOrder
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF Init, InitServerVars, TotalOrder
<1>7. Init => LocalPrimaryOrder
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitServerVarsL,
    LocalPrimaryOrder
<1>8. Init => GlobalPrimaryOrder
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF Init, InitServerVars, GlobalPrimaryOrder
<1>9. Init => PrimaryIntegrity
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitServerVarsL,
    PrimaryIntegrity, IsLeader, LOOKING, LEADING
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, <1>8, <1>9
  DEF AGProperties

\* Only processing ACKEPOCH can add a leader to the epoch registry.
AGRegistryUnchangedSteps ==
  \/ \E i, j \in Server: FLEReceiveNotmsg(i, j)
  \/ \E i \in Server: FLENotmsgTimeout(i)
  \/ \E i \in Server: FLEHandleNotmsg(i)
  \/ \E i \in Server: FLEWaitNewNotmsg(i)
  \/ \E i, j \in Server: PartitionStart(i, j)
  \/ \E i, j \in Server: PartitionRecover(i, j)
  \/ \E i \in Server: NodeCrash(i)
  \/ \E i \in Server: NodeStart(i)
  \/ \E i, j \in Server: ConnectAndFollowerSendFOLLOWERINFO(i, j)
  \/ \E i, j \in Server: LeaderProcessFOLLOWERINFO(i, j)
  \/ \E i, j \in Server: FollowerProcessLEADERINFO(i, j)
  \/ \E i, j \in Server: LeaderSyncFollower(i, j)
  \/ \E i, j \in Server: FollowerProcessSyncMessage(i, j)
  \/ \E i, j \in Server: FollowerProcessPROPOSALInSync(i, j)
  \/ \E i, j \in Server: FollowerProcessCOMMITInSync(i, j)
  \/ \E i, j \in Server: FollowerProcessNEWLEADER(i, j)
  \/ \E i, j \in Server: LeaderProcessACKLD(i, j)
  \/ \E i, j \in Server: FollowerProcessUPTODATE(i, j)
  \/ \E i \in Server: LeaderProcessRequest(i)
  \/ \E i, j \in Server: FollowerProcessPROPOSAL(i, j)
  \/ \E i, j \in Server: LeaderProcessACK(i, j)
  \/ \E i, j \in Server: FollowerProcessCOMMIT(i, j)

LEMMA AGRegistryFrame == AGRegistryUnchangedSteps => UNCHANGED epochLeader
<1>1. (\E i, j \in Server: FLEReceiveNotmsg(i, j)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF FLEReceiveNotmsg, verifyVars
<1>2. (\E i \in Server: FLENotmsgTimeout(i)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF FLENotmsgTimeout, verifyVars
<1>3. (\E i \in Server: FLEHandleNotmsg(i)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF FLEHandleNotmsg, verifyVars
<1>4. (\E i \in Server: FLEWaitNewNotmsg(i)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF FLEWaitNewNotmsg, verifyVars
<1>5. (\E i, j \in Server: PartitionStart(i, j)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF PartitionStart, verifyVars
<1>6. (\E i, j \in Server: PartitionRecover(i, j)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF PartitionRecover, verifyVars
<1>7. (\E i \in Server: NodeCrash(i)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF NodeCrash, verifyVars
<1>8. (\E i \in Server: NodeStart(i)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF NodeStart, verifyVars
<1>9. (\E i, j \in Server: ConnectAndFollowerSendFOLLOWERINFO(i, j)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF ConnectAndFollowerSendFOLLOWERINFO, verifyVars
<1>10. (\E i, j \in Server: LeaderProcessFOLLOWERINFO(i, j)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF LeaderProcessFOLLOWERINFO, verifyVars
<1>11. (\E i, j \in Server: FollowerProcessLEADERINFO(i, j)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF FollowerProcessLEADERINFO, verifyVars
<1>12. (\E i, j \in Server: LeaderSyncFollower(i, j)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF LeaderSyncFollower, verifyVars
<1>13. (\E i, j \in Server: FollowerProcessSyncMessage(i, j)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF FollowerProcessSyncMessage, verifyVars
<1>14. (\E i, j \in Server: FollowerProcessPROPOSALInSync(i, j)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF FollowerProcessPROPOSALInSync, verifyVars
<1>15. (\E i, j \in Server: FollowerProcessCOMMITInSync(i, j)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF FollowerProcessCOMMITInSync, verifyVars
<1>16. (\E i, j \in Server: FollowerProcessNEWLEADER(i, j)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF FollowerProcessNEWLEADER, verifyVars
<1>17. (\E i, j \in Server: LeaderProcessACKLD(i, j)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF LeaderProcessACKLD, verifyVars
<1>18. (\E i, j \in Server: FollowerProcessUPTODATE(i, j)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF FollowerProcessUPTODATE, verifyVars
<1>19. (\E i \in Server: LeaderProcessRequest(i)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF LeaderProcessRequest, verifyVars
<1>20. (\E i, j \in Server: FollowerProcessPROPOSAL(i, j)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF FollowerProcessPROPOSAL, verifyVars
<1>21. (\E i, j \in Server: LeaderProcessACK(i, j)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF LeaderProcessACK, verifyVars
<1>22. (\E i, j \in Server: FollowerProcessCOMMIT(i, j)) => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF FollowerProcessCOMMIT, verifyVars
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, <1>8, <1>9, <1>10, <1>11, <1>12, <1>13, <1>14, <1>15, <1>16, <1>17, <1>18, <1>19, <1>20, <1>21, <1>22
  DEF AGRegistryUnchangedSteps

AGRegistryType == epochLeader \in [1..MAXEPOCH -> SUBSET Server]

LEMMA AGRegistryTypeInit == Init => AGRegistryType
BY SMTT("r3") DEF Init, InitVerifyVars, AGRegistryType

LEMMA AGRegistryTypeStep == AGRegistryType /\ [Next]_vars => AGRegistryType'
<1>1. AGRegistryType /\ UNCHANGED epochLeader => AGRegistryType'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF AGRegistryType
<1>2. ASSUME AGRegistryType,
             NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
             LeaderProcessACKEPOCH(i, j)
      PROVE AGRegistryType'
  BY <1>2, SMTT("r10") DEF AGRegistryType, LeaderProcessACKEPOCH
<1>3. AGRegistryType /\ Next => AGRegistryType'
  BY <1>1, <1>2, AGRegistryFrame, SMTT("r3")
    DEF Next, AGRegistryUnchangedSteps
<1>4. UNCHANGED vars => UNCHANGED epochLeader
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF vars, verifyVars
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>3, <1>4

LEMMA AGRegistryInvariant == Spec => []AGRegistryType
BY AGRegistryTypeInit, AGRegistryTypeStep, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Spec => []Leadership1
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_Leadership1.tla
<1>1. Init => Leadership1
  BY AGInitialSafety DEF AGProperties
<1>2. Leadership1 /\ Next => Leadership1'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF Leadership1, Next
<1>3. Leadership1 /\ UNCHANGED vars => Leadership1'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF Leadership1, vars, serverVars, electionVars,
    leaderVars, followerVars, verifyVars, msgVars, envVars,
    IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLeader, IsMyLearner
<1>4. Leadership1 /\ [Next]_vars => Leadership1'
  BY <1>2, <1>3
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>4, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_Leadership1.tla

THEOREM Spec => []Leadership2
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_Leadership2.tla
<1>1. Init => Leadership2
  BY AGInitialSafety DEF AGProperties
<1>2. AGRegistryType /\ Leadership2 /\ Next => Leadership2'
  <2>1. Leadership2 /\ AGRegistryUnchangedSteps => Leadership2'
    BY AGRegistryFrame, SMTT("r3") DEF Leadership2
  <2>2. ASSUME AGRegistryType, Leadership2,
               NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
               LeaderProcessACKEPOCH(i, j)
        PROVE Leadership2'
    BY <2>2, SMTT("r3") DEF AGRegistryType, Leadership2, LeaderProcessACKEPOCH,
      LeaderTurnToSynchronization, LeaderShutdown, ZabTimeoutInCluster,
      varsL, serverVarsL
  <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2 DEF Next, AGRegistryUnchangedSteps
<1>3. Leadership2 /\ UNCHANGED vars => Leadership2'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF Leadership2, vars, serverVars, electionVars,
    leaderVars, followerVars, verifyVars, msgVars, envVars,
    IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLeader, IsMyLearner
<1>4. AGRegistryType /\ Leadership2 /\ [Next]_vars => Leadership2'
  BY <1>2, <1>3
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>4, AGRegistryInvariant, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_Leadership2.tla

THEOREM Spec => []PrefixConsistency
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_PrefixConsistency.tla
<1>1. Init => PrefixConsistency
  BY AGInitialSafety DEF AGProperties
<1>2. PrefixConsistency /\ Next => PrefixConsistency'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF PrefixConsistency, Next
<1>3. PrefixConsistency /\ UNCHANGED vars => PrefixConsistency'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF PrefixConsistency, vars, serverVars, electionVars,
    leaderVars, followerVars, verifyVars, msgVars, envVars,
    IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLeader, IsMyLearner
<1>4. PrefixConsistency /\ [Next]_vars => PrefixConsistency'
  BY <1>2, <1>3
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>4, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_PrefixConsistency.tla

THEOREM Spec => []Integrity
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_Integrity.tla
<1>1. Init => Integrity
  BY AGInitialSafety DEF AGProperties
<1>2. Integrity /\ Next => Integrity'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF Integrity, Next
<1>3. Integrity /\ UNCHANGED vars => Integrity'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF Integrity, vars, serverVars, electionVars,
    leaderVars, followerVars, verifyVars, msgVars, envVars,
    IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLeader, IsMyLearner
<1>4. Integrity /\ [Next]_vars => Integrity'
  BY <1>2, <1>3
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>4, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_Integrity.tla

THEOREM Spec => []Agreement
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_Agreement.tla
<1>1. Init => Agreement
  BY AGInitialSafety DEF AGProperties
<1>2. Agreement /\ Next => Agreement'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF Agreement, Next
<1>3. Agreement /\ UNCHANGED vars => Agreement'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF Agreement, vars, serverVars, electionVars,
    leaderVars, followerVars, verifyVars, msgVars, envVars,
    IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLeader, IsMyLearner
<1>4. Agreement /\ [Next]_vars => Agreement'
  BY <1>2, <1>3
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>4, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_Agreement.tla

THEOREM Spec => []TotalOrder
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_TotalOrder.tla
<1>1. Init => TotalOrder
  BY AGInitialSafety DEF AGProperties
<1>2. TotalOrder /\ Next => TotalOrder'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF TotalOrder, Next
<1>3. TotalOrder /\ UNCHANGED vars => TotalOrder'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF TotalOrder, vars, serverVars, electionVars,
    leaderVars, followerVars, verifyVars, msgVars, envVars,
    IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLeader, IsMyLearner
<1>4. TotalOrder /\ [Next]_vars => TotalOrder'
  BY <1>2, <1>3
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>4, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_TotalOrder.tla

THEOREM Spec => []LocalPrimaryOrder
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_LocalPrimaryOrder.tla
<1>1. Init => LocalPrimaryOrder
  BY AGInitialSafety DEF AGProperties
<1>2. LocalPrimaryOrder /\ Next => LocalPrimaryOrder'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF LocalPrimaryOrder, Next
<1>3. LocalPrimaryOrder /\ UNCHANGED vars => LocalPrimaryOrder'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF LocalPrimaryOrder, vars, serverVars, electionVars,
    leaderVars, followerVars, verifyVars, msgVars, envVars,
    IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLeader, IsMyLearner
<1>4. LocalPrimaryOrder /\ [Next]_vars => LocalPrimaryOrder'
  BY <1>2, <1>3
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>4, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_LocalPrimaryOrder.tla

THEOREM Spec => []GlobalPrimaryOrder
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_GlobalPrimaryOrder.tla
<1>1. Init => GlobalPrimaryOrder
  BY AGInitialSafety DEF AGProperties
<1>2. GlobalPrimaryOrder /\ Next => GlobalPrimaryOrder'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF GlobalPrimaryOrder, Next
<1>3. GlobalPrimaryOrder /\ UNCHANGED vars => GlobalPrimaryOrder'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF GlobalPrimaryOrder, vars, serverVars, electionVars,
    leaderVars, followerVars, verifyVars, msgVars, envVars,
    IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLeader, IsMyLearner
<1>4. GlobalPrimaryOrder /\ [Next]_vars => GlobalPrimaryOrder'
  BY <1>2, <1>3
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>4, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_GlobalPrimaryOrder.tla

THEOREM Spec => []PrimaryIntegrity
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_PrimaryIntegrity.tla
<1>1. Init => PrimaryIntegrity
  BY AGInitialSafety DEF AGProperties
<1>2. PrimaryIntegrity /\ Next => PrimaryIntegrity'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF PrimaryIntegrity, Next
<1>3. PrimaryIntegrity /\ UNCHANGED vars => PrimaryIntegrity'
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF PrimaryIntegrity, vars, serverVars, electionVars,
    leaderVars, followerVars, verifyVars, msgVars, envVars,
    IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLeader, IsMyLearner
<1>4. PrimaryIntegrity /\ [Next]_vars => PrimaryIntegrity'
  BY <1>2, <1>3
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>4, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper_LowLevel/ZkV3_7_0_PrimaryIntegrity.tla
